description.zh: 复制通道名称，用于标识复制链路。
description.en: A unique name for the replication channel. This name identifies the replication link.
The instance ID. You can call the `DescribeDBInstances` operation to obtain this ID.

description.zh: 主数据库主机地址，支持IP或域名。
description.en: The endpoint of the primary database, which can be an IP address or a domain name.

description.zh: 主数据库密码，用于验证复制用户，需要提前经过Base64编码。
description.en: The Base64-encoded password for the replication user account.

description.zh: 主数据库端口号，通常为3306（MySQL）
description.en: The port of the primary database. For example, the default port for MySQL is 3306.

description.zh: 主数据库用户名，用于建立复制连接。
description.en: The username for the replication account on the primary database.
The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds create-db-instance-replication --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id rm-bp1234567890abcdef --channel-name replication-channel-001 --master-host 192.168.1.100 --master-port 3306 --master-user repl_user --master-password U2VjdXJlUGFzczEyMyE= --region cn-hangzhou
